The Account object has one trigger, one record-triggered flow, no validation rules and a small Apex stack behind the trigger. I ran everything against `AgentforceOrg` (`<org-username>`) because no default target org is configured and it's the only authenticated org.

## Inventory

| Type | Component | Details |
|---|---|---|
| Trigger | `AccountTrigger` | Active, API 62. Runs before insert and before update. |
| Flow | `Append_Billing_Country_to_Account_Name` | Active version 8. Record-triggered, before-save, on create and update. |
| Validation rules | none | The Tooling API returned 0 rows for Account. |
| Handler | `AccountTriggerHandler` | Has `beforeInsert`, `beforeUpdate` and a `setBypassTrigger(Boolean)` switch. |
| Service | `AccountService` | `preventDuplicateAccounts(accounts, oldMap)` |
| Selector | `AccountSelector` | `selectByPhoneNumbers(Set<String>)` queries `Account` with `WITH SECURITY_ENFORCED`. |
| Tests | `AccountTrigger_Test`, `AccountTriggerHandler_Test`, `AccountService_Test`, `AccountSelector_Test` | |

## Dependencies

```
Save of an Account
 ├─ 1. Flow: Append_Billing_Country_to_Account_Name   (before-save flow, runs first)
 │      sets $Record.Name = Name & " - " & BillingCountry
 └─ 2. Trigger: AccountTrigger  (before insert / before update)
        └─ AccountTriggerHandler.beforeInsert / beforeUpdate   (skipped if bypassTrigger = true)
             └─ AccountService.preventDuplicateAccounts
                  └─ AccountSelector.selectByPhoneNumbers   (SOQL on Account.Phone)
                  └─ acc.Phone.addError('An Account with this phone number already exists: …')
```

- **Duplicate check:** it only looks at phone numbers that are new or changed. On update it ignores a match against the record's own Id.
- **Tests:**
  - `AccountTrigger_Test` only checks that the trigger fires.
  - `AccountTriggerHandler_Test` tests the trigger end to end through DML, including bypass and bulk cases.
  - `AccountService_Test` and `AccountSelector_Test` test those classes directly.
- **Flow versus trigger:** the flow and the Apex stack don't call each other. They only interact through the order of execution. They touch different fields (`Name` and `BillingCountry` for the flow, `Phone` for Apex), so I found no conflict.

## Other Apex touching Account

- `RecordSelectorController` is generic and works on any object. It maps the `001` prefix to `'Account'` in `getObjectApiNameFromPrefix`. It can query Account and update an Account field, but it has no compile-time dependency on the Account classes.
- None of the Lead and Case classes reference Account. I read all of their bodies.

## Things worth checking

1. **The flow doesn't match its description.** The description says it only runs when `Name` or `BillingCountry` changes. The active version's start element has no entry conditions or filters, so it runs on every create and update. It stays idempotent only because of the `EndsWith " - Country"` check.
2. **A newer flow version exists.** The latest version (`301gK000014Xy5pQAC`) isn't the active one (`301gK000014L4loQAC`, v8). It's probably an unactivated draft, and I didn't inspect it.
3. **No deactivation check for the flow.** The handler's `setBypassTrigger` only bypasses the trigger, not the flow.
4. **Possible phone-matching gap.** The duplicate check compares exact `Phone` strings, so `111-111-1111` and `(111) 111-1111` count as different. Account names that the flow changes also won't affect it.

I couldn't search the full class-body export on disk because the file-reading tools were disabled in this session. Instead I queried the specific class bodies directly. Reflecting that, the "no other Account references" finding covers the 27 classes in the org by name. I read the bodies of 15 non-test classes and the 4 Account test classes, not the other test classes. I didn't check Process Builder, workflow rules, or Account-related Lightning components and LWCs.
